# Ida

|  |  |

## Personality

Watchful, dry and unafraid of the dark. She knows the old quarters by sound alone.

## Story

Ida walks the old quarters' lanes each night for the Royal Guard, with a lantern and a stout stick. She has heard something scratching under the old drains that she cannot explain.
